displayName.ja: 【対魔新年】 井河　アサギ

profile.ja: 対魔忍を率いる総隊長にして最強の対魔忍と目されている正義のくノ一。カオス・アリーナでの死闘で朧を倒すも恋人・沢木恭介を失う。自身も死闘の中で朧に囚われ、邪悪な魔界医療技術によって肉体を改造されるも、７年前に捕虜にした魔科医・桐生の手によって元の肉体に治療されている。天才的な剣術と体術、人知を超える光速のスピードが武器。また、東京キングダムの死闘では対魔忍の中に潜む真正の魔の力に覚醒し、その能力を格段に向上させて「隼の術」の極意を体得する。政府によって設立された対魔忍養成学校・五車学園の校長を務めている。得物は忍者刀。そんな彼女、正月休みといえども完全なオフはなく、正装をして挨拶回りに行っている。わずかに空いた時間で神社へやって来たアサギは、破魔矢を買い、本年も任務の無事を祈るのだった。
profile.en: (Igawa Asagi, she/her) She is the supreme commander of the Taimanin and is regarded as the strongest Taimanin—a righteous kunoichi. In a deadly clash at the Chaos Arena she defeats Oboro, but loses her lover Sawaki Kyousuke. She herself is captured by Oboro during the battle and has her body altered with evil Demon Realm medical technology, yet seven years later a demon scientist named Kiryu, whom she had taken prisoner, restores her original body. She wields genius-level swordsmanship and martial arts, and her weapon is light-speed speed beyond human comprehension. During the Tokyo Kingdom's bloodshed she awakens the true demonic power hidden within the Taimanin, dramatically enhancing her abilities and mastering the ultimate "Haya no Jutsu." She serves as principal of Gosha Academy, the government-established Taimanin training school. Her weapon of choice is a ninja sword. Even during the New Year holidays she has no true time off; she dons formal attire to make rounds of greetings. In the brief spare moments she visits a shrine, buys a Hama-ya, and prays for the safety of this year's missions.

text.ja: 一年の計は元旦にあり――お昼になる前に、気持ちを新たにしておきなさいね
text.en: A year's plan starts on New Year's—make sure to refresh your spirit before noon.

text.ja: あけましておめでとう。今年もよろしくね、隊長さん？
text.en: Happy New Year. Looking forward to another great year, Captain?

text.ja: あら、初詣？　結構なことね、年始のお参りは気が引き締まると同時に、自身の目標を定められる、いい機会になるわ
text.en: Oh, a first shrine visit? Not bad, New Year's prayers sharpen your mind and let you set goals—a great opportunity.

text.ja: ふふっ、先生とお参りすることになるなんて、気が休まらないかしら？　私もオフなのだから、気を張らなくていいのよ？
text.en: Heh, going to the shrine with Sensei, you can't relax? I'm off as well, so you don't have to push yourself.

text.ja: お参りも済んだし、少し休んで行かない？　お茶屋さんがあるわ……あのお店の抹茶ぜんざいがおいしいって、さくらが言っていたかしら
text.en: Now that the shrine visit's over, want to take a little break? There's a tea shop... I heard Sakura say their matcha zenzai is delicious.

text.ja: 今日のことは、みんなには内緒よ？　生徒の一人を贔屓したと思われたら、大変だもの……もちろん、時子先生にもね？
text.en: Keep today secret from everyone, okay? If I'm thought to be favoring a student, that'll be trouble...including Sensei Tokiko, of course.

text.ja: 一応はオフだけれど、これでも挨拶回りの途中なのよ……まぁ、一緒にお参りする時間くらいは、あると思うわ
text.en: I'm technically off, but I'm still on my rounds...well, we should have time to go to the shrine together.

text.ja: 私が言うのもなんだけれど……さすがはふうまの当主様ね。紋付の礼装、とてもよく似合っているわ
text.en: I know I'm the one saying this, but as expected of the Fuuma head, that crested formal wear looks perfect on you.
